message: No detected input validation: The only validation performed is a file extension check against a whitelist (exts), but there is no schema validation, dtype checking, value-range guards, or structural validation of the uploaded data content.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data is loaded from local file uploads or local paths; there is no fetching from remote sources, and no checksum, signature, or authentication mechanisms are implemented.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: Although a `remove_outliers` function exists in utils.py, it is incomplete (commented-out logic, no return value) and is never called in the data preparation pipeline; `clean()` only calls `drop_missing_data`, so no effective poisoning defense is applied.

No detected model integrity verification: No pretrained models or serialized model files are loaded anywhere in the code; models are trained from scratch each time, so no integrity verification (hash check, signature, pinned revision) is performed or needed, but the control is simply absent.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before training in any of the algorithm modules.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, etc.) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used in any training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/test splitting is performed, the test set is stored as an instance variable accessible throughout the session with no isolation guarantees, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no independent validation mechanism to prevent metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path only checks file extension against a whitelist and uses a try/except for algorithm lookup, but there is no validation of input shape, data types, value ranges, or schema enforcement before passing data to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (predictions, metrics, classification reports) are returned directly via jsonify without any NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or sanity validation.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses classical ML models (linear regression, SVM, k-means, logistic regression, Naive Bayes), not LLMs, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
